pool_assessment: The pool was differentiated primarily by depth of hands-on AI/ML ownership, strength of research evidence, selective lab or international experience, quantified model outcomes, and ability to ship full-stack systems. The finalists combine advanced work in RAG, computer vision, NLP, multimodal modeling, or applied ML with credible software engineering evidence; candidates with mainly generic web development, design, or lightly documented exposure ranked below them.

top_8_rankings.headline_rationale: Strongest overall combination of selective international research, genuine deep-learning ownership, production open-source engineering, and measurable external impact. His DFKI work and GSoC contribution materially exceed typical entry-level project experience.
supporting_evidence: "Google Summer of Code -- CVAT.ai"
Improved CVAT with a configurable shortcut system and achieved 100% test coverage
"Deutsches Forschungszentrum für Künstliche Intelligenz"
Engineered semi-supervised settlement detection using FixMatch, domain adaptation, pseudo-label refinement, and SAM2 on H100/A100 infrastructure; npm package had 500+ downloads

top_8_rankings.headline_rationale: Best direct match to the target stack among the finalists: published RAG research, strong GPA, Python/React/Next.js/Kubernetes exposure, and multiple end-to-end product builds. The COLING publication is a major differentiator.
supporting_evidence: "FUSIONRAG: Enhancing Regulatory Document Analysis" published at COLING 2025
Combined OpenAI embeddings, BM25, FAISS, and rank fusion for retrieval and answer generation
Built Scototo with Next.js, SQL, Socket.IO, Tailwind, and Clerk; developed Kisan farmer-support application

supporting_evidence: "A Video Based Multi-Task Learning Model for Autonomous Driving"
Achieved 82.4% mIoU on VIL-100 lane segmentation
Built a multimodal medical VQA system using CNNs plus LSTMs/Transformers and evaluated with accuracy, BLEU, and METEOR
Developed an LLM-driven FastAPI website assistant and transformer-based table QA system
